title: Starwoven Dreams

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered bohemian ballroom ensemble featuring a cropped structured bustier with a cascading multi-tiered maxi skirt, asymmetric draped panels, and detached sheer arm sleeves.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A sheer lavender veil pinned with golden chains and beaded strands, draped over the head and falling around the face, paired with a beaded forehead chain.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless bandeau bodice in lavender with a sweetheart neckline, adorned with butterfly and star motifs, gold beadwork, dangling chains at the waist, and detached sheer sleeves with armbands and elaborate trim.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A voluminous tiered maxi skirt in violet with sheer overlay panels, scalloped lace hems, gold coin fringing, star appliqués, and feather accents, paired with strappy beaded sandals.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating golden star and butterfly embellishments, dangling feather charms, and delicate chain tassels that scatter light around the figure.
